summary: Phase 7A tested end to end (dry run, no calls placed). Backend: added test_ai_calling_phase7a_api.py with 12 live-URL tests plus the existing 17 scratch-DB unit tests, all 29 passing. The full AI-calling suite (minus provider_phase31) gave 210 passed, 14 skipped. Covered: the switches GET/POST with the 8-row policy, both switches ON with no jobs created, 409 on a stale expected_version, Live OFF keeps live_dispatch_authorized=false, authorize returns 423, 401 with no auth and 403 with no CSRF, consent on create (no_consent/ready), the old approve/revoke/bulk endpoints return 404/405, consent withdraw/regrant, Do Not Call clears consent, a phone change resets consent unless fresh consent is given, ?consent=granted filters, call-now is 423 (sent with a wrong name), and test-calls/status shows single_call_enabled=false. Frontend: Settings mode-switches panel (switches, label, warning, source-test/live blockers, live-dispatch-status OFF, policy table with all 8 rows correct), toggling Live ON and back updates label and blockers, Consent Preview (unchecked by default, result text, only GETs made), and estop-state ON. Testing page: manual add without consent shows 'Not recorded'; grant, withdraw and Do Not Call work; filter-consent works; call-now is disabled; the UI delete works. Dashboard stat-consented=1. History still shows the Phase 4B Raj call. Live dry-run preview and planning work. Final DB state checked: ai_calls=1, ai_call_jobs=1, ai_test_candidates=1 (Raj, consent Recorded), bb_registrations/pipeline_data untouched, emergency_stop=true, ai_test ON, ai_live OFF, live_dispatch_authorized=false, provider settings/audit hashes unchanged.

minor.issue: These state-changing endpoints do not call _csrf() (switches/authorize/call-now do). Not a call path, but consent is a gate input, so it should probably have the same X-CSRF-Intent protection.
